Finely directed by scholar and dramaturg Gabrielle Randle-Bent, and performed with grace and dignity by talented actress Annabel Armour, it touches every patron in a different way.
Annabel Armour beautifully portrays Joan Didion in this one-woman show “The Year of Magical Thinking.”

cn.t: Annabel Armour delivers an extraordinary, emotionally powerful performance in this demanding one-woman show about Joan Didion's grief, though the 100-minute narrative proves intellectually challenging.
